stories.headline: Mrs. Holt Arrives with the Last Four Ducks; the Ceremony Is Brief; Nothing More Needs to Be Said; Everything Has Been Said
body: Elspeth Holt arrived at half past nine this morning carrying a wicker basket, a covered tin, and four rubber ducks. She did not knock. She came around the side of the house, which Steve had left open in what he later described as 'a hunch,' set the basket on the garden table, and said, 'That's the lot.'

The four ducks were removed in order and placed on the Jeep's bonnet, roof rail, nearside mirror, and the small flat behind the spare. Each wore a hat. A miniature stovepipe — nearly certainly the detective's — went to the bonnet. A soft velvet beret, the colour of good moss, went to the roof rail. A tiny flat cap, the working kind, went to the mirror. The last duck wore nothing complicated: a plain knitted beanie, rust-coloured, with a small white pompom, and it went at the back, where the basket used to sit when Steve loads the trail gear.

Mrs. Holt stepped back, folded her arms, and looked at all eleven ducks on the Jeep. The household looked with her. Nobody counted aloud; everybody counted. After a suitable interval, she confirmed — without being asked — that the deerstalker was for Lucy ('the one who knows things and won't say'), and the tam-o'-shanter was for Jersey ('the one who needs to be warm'). Neither animal was present to dispute this. Lucy, sources indicate, was already aware. Steve updated the hat log. The tin contained shortbread. The Jeep has not moved all day, as though it understands that some arrangements should be admired before they are driven anywhere.

serial.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt

stories.headline: Wednesday's Vault Audit Proceeds Without Incident; Christine Cited as the Reason; Goblins Decline to Confirm; the Audit Proceeds Without Incident
body: The quarterly audit of Vault Corridor Seven concluded this Wednesday inside the allocated window — a circumstance so unusual that senior auditors checked the schedule twice and then, finding it correct, declined to comment. No attributable statement was issued. A source described as 'grudgingly senior' was willing to confirm only that Liaison Coordination had been 'not unhelpful.'

Christine was observed leaving the building at a reasonable hour, carrying only her notebook and the expression of someone who had anticipated every objection before it was raised and arranged for it to have nowhere to go.

stories.headline: Steve Turns His Attention to the Garden Gate Latch; Latch Cooperates Immediately; Steve Regards This with Mild Suspicion
body: Having resolved the directional disagreement with the side gate earlier in the week, Steve moved Wednesday afternoon to the garden gate latch, which had been catching on the second attempt since approximately March. The latch, upon being approached with tools, released on the first attempt, aligned without adjustment, and has since operated correctly on every trial. Steve tested it six times. He is not confident.
The latch offered no explanation. The Jeep, reached for comment, declined to speculate but appeared sympathetic.

stories.headline: Ministry Working Group on Unexplained Outdoor Phenomena Requests Voluntary Sightings Data; No Phenomena Reported; Working Group Thanks the Public for Its Candour
body: The Ministry's newly convened Working Group on Unexplained Outdoor Phenomena issued a voluntary data-collection notice this Wednesday, inviting members of the public to report any unusual sightings in highland or gorge terrain over the preceding quarter. By close of business, seventeen owls had arrived. Fourteen described sunsets. Two described the sound of a Jeep on a ridge. One described a rubber duck in a tricorn hat and was asked to elaborate; the elaboration was filed under 'P' for Pending.

The Working Group is expected to meet again in a fortnight. A glowing briefcase of uncertain provenance, spotted briefly in the corridor outside the meeting room, had departed before anyone thought to ask about it.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Was aware the deerstalker was hers from the day it arrived. Has no comment on how she knew. Has never had a comment.
Ellie: Examined all eleven ducks with great care and attention, then returned to examine them again, in case they were different ducks. They were the same ducks. She found this pleasing.
Jersey: Has been informed the tam-o'-shanter is his. He accepted this news from his position on the warm cushion with the dignity of a gentleman who expected nothing less.
founding_editor_note: Eleven ducks, all hatted, all placed, not a wonky one among them. That's a finished job. I'd have added a bracket. — D.

in_brief.sport: Intramural Levitation League reports record attendance; records also indicate Christine's vault audit finished before the first whistle, which the League considers frankly unsporting.
in_brief.forecast: Fair and still on the ridge. Ducks settled. No disturbance expected. Good evening for standing in the garden and looking at the Jeep.

storyline_updates.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Wednesday morning. Mrs. Holt arrived with the final four ducks, placed all eleven on the Jeep, confirmed the deerstalker for Lucy and the tam for Jersey, and left shortbread. The hat log is complete. The Jeep has eleven hatted ducks and has not been moved. Arc warmly and fully resolved.
